en.headline: Hong Kong drops criminal damage charge against ship captain over Baltic pipeline
en.dek: Prosecutors withdrew the case against Wan Wenguo after failing to contact mainland witnesses; he pleaded guilty to lesser offences and is expected to leave for the mainland.
body: Hong Kong marine authorities have withdrawn the criminal damage prosecution against the former captain of a Hong Kong-flagged container ship accused of severing a Baltic Sea gas pipeline three years ago.

A prosecutor from the Marine Department told Eastern Magistrates' Courts on Wednesday that several witnesses from the mainland could not be contacted, leading to the discontinuation of proceedings against 43-year-old Wan Wenguo. The incident in October 2023 involved the Newnew Polar Bear and was said in court to have caused about HK$400 million in damage to the pipeline linking Finland and Estonia.

Wan, who had been in custody, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to two separate summons offences: continuing the voyage without sufficient anchors and failing to submit required daily reports. He was fined for those offences.

He is expected to be referred to the Immigration Department for arrangements to depart for the mainland. The Department of Justice has confirmed the criminal charge was dropped and said prosecutorial decisions are made according to the facts of each case.

zh.headline: 港方撤銷船長破壞波羅的海管道刑事控罪
zh.dek: 控方因未能聯絡內地證人而撤銷針對萬文國的刑事毀壞控罪，他承認較輕微罪行後預計返回內地。
body: 香港海事當局已撤銷針對一艘香港註冊貨櫃船前船長的刑事毀壞檢控。該船長被指三年前在波羅的海切斷一條連接芬蘭與愛沙尼亞的天然氣管道。
海事處檢察官周三在東區裁判法院表示，多名內地證人未能聯絡，因此中止針對43歲萬文國的法律程序。案件涉及2023年10月「新新北極熊」號，法庭獲告知事件造成約4億元損失。
萬文國此前一直被羈押，周三就兩項傳票罪行認罪：在沒有足夠船錨下繼續航行，以及未按規定提交每日報告，並被判罰款。
他預計將交由入境事務處安排返回內地。律政司確認刑事控罪已撤銷，並表示所有檢控決定均根據案件實際事實作出。
